subject: Billing mandate & collector onboarding — renewal term change
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@lumenhealth.com>, AP Finance <ap_finance@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing mandate & collector onboarding — renewal term change

Hi Marco / AP team,

Thanks again for the renewal call earlier this week. As discussed, the renewal addendum will reflect the capacity increase from 250k to 400k tokens/month and the shift in the billing cadence tied to the term change. To keep the implementation timeline (start of September) we need three things from your side: 

1) Signed PO reflecting the updated commitment and billing entity (attached stub).
2) W9 (or W-8 if applicable) for the invoicing entity so we can update our tax records.
3) Preferred payment collector/mandate form for ACH/direct-debit (if you want Redwood to initiate collector pull).

We're happy to accept a PO with Net60 terms, but we need that indicated on the PO itself or via a one-line confirmation from your AP team. If you prefer Net30 instead, please flag that now so we can route the contract accordingly.

I attached the PO draft (LumenHealth_PO_87654.pdf) and the DocuSign renewal addendum link — we can auto-fill the billing contact and payment instructions once we receive the W9 and PO.

Next steps I propose: 
- Marco: confirm Net terms and who will sign the PO on your side.
- AP: send W9 and indicate if you want Redwood's collector to be authorized (we will provide an ACH mandate template).
- Vivek: I'll loop you into the onboarding once the PO is signed so scheduling is ready.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: LumenHealth_PO_87654.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
DocuSign: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/abc123

From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@lumenhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Finance <ap_finance@lumenhealth.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing mandate & collector onboarding — renewal term change

Kimberly,

Thanks — we reviewed internally. A couple quick items:

• We can confirm the upgrade to 400k tokens/month and the PO will be routed from our central procurement team.
• We would like to move to Net60 for this renewal; please reflect Net60 on the addendum.
• I attached our W9, and AP can confirm whether we want Redwood to set up collector pull. At the moment AP is leaning toward maintaining our current ACH push, but we can consider collector if it simplifies billing.

I'll route the PO to legal for signature. Can you confirm whether DocuSign needs a separate signature from our Treasury team for ACH mandates? If so, we'll include them in the signature routing.

—Marco
Marco Diaz
Head of Strategic Partnerships, LumenHealth
marco.diaz@lumenhealth.com
Attachment: W9-LumenHealth.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@lumenhealth.com>, AP Finance <ap_finance@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Aug 2028 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Billing mandate & collector onboarding — renewal term change

Kim / Vivek —

I can take the billing-side work once we have Marco's confirmation and the W9. Two quick notes from finance ops: 

1) For Net60 we will generate an invoice schedule that shows the first invoice pro-rated for September (start date) and then monthly thereafter. Please confirm if the customer wants monthly invoices or quarterly invoices on Net60.
2) If LumenHealth wants Redwood to be the collector (push vs pull), legal needs a signed ACH mandate (we have a standard template). If they prefer to push ACH from their treasury, we only need a signed PO + W9 and the remittance contact.

I dropped a draft DocuSign addendum into the shared drive (DocuSign-Renewal-Addendum.pdf) and will update Net terms once AP confirms.

Attaching our standard ACH Mandate template for reference — I'm happy to pre-fill it with LumenHealth details once the AP remittance contact is confirmed.

Best,

Priyom Das
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
Attachment: DocuSign-Renewal-Addendum.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
Attachment: Redwood_ACH_Mandate_Template.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Hi Kimberly / Priyom,

Attached is the signed PO (LumenHealth_PO_87654.pdf) and our W9. We confirmed with Treasury — LumenHealth will remain on ACH push for now (no collector pull). Net60 is confirmed on the PO.

We completed the DocuSign signature for the renewal addendum; the signed copy is available via the link below.

DocuSign signed: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/abc123 (signed by LumenHealth Legal & Treasury)
Attachment: LumenHealth_PO_87654_signed.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Please proceed with the invoice schedule and kick off customer onboarding once the administrative items are updated in your billing system. Let us know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
AP Finance Team

ap_finance@lumenhealth.com
